messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary group "canary-A" error-rate +3.2% and p95 latency +38% for /v1/chat (us-east-1). Auto-rollback rule triggered. Suggested action: auto-rollback to v3.0.1 unless manually locked. https://deploy.redwood/telemetry/canary-A :rotating_light:

lin: seeing the spike. it's mostly 20-30 token requests. might be batching change. any dedicated customers pinned?

josh: no dedicated pins in us-east-1. a couple of high-QPS hosted routes affected. I pushed a temporary batching throttle flag to the canary hosts 6m ago, slight improvement only.

product-pm: product wants to avoid auto-rollback unless it's impacting sessions. can we hold for 10m and gather logs? we need release note phrasing if we revert.

lin: i'm leaning manual rollback + pin so we can coordinate comms. auto-rollback will scramble release notes and might trigger the release window lock. tagging kate + cs-lead for customer messaging sync.

kate: thanks. if we roll back, we'll use the short template and send only if customers see errors or performance impact >5m. default: no external email unless dedicated customers are affected.

cs-lead: i'll prepare targeted list in case we need to message. please confirm before send.

josh: ops proposal: 1) set manual-lock on deploybot to prevent auto-rollback, 2) pin hosted region to v3.0.1, 3) run a controlled rollback of canary-A, 4) hold change window for 1 hour for monitoring.

lin: command to lock auto-rollback:

```
deployctl lock --reason "manual-review-latency-spike" --actor lin
```

josh: pin command (will run after lock):

```
releasectl pin --svc hosted --region us-east-1 --version v3.0.1 --by josh
```

sre-oncall: monitoring dashboards. if p95 doesn't drop within 5m of rollback we escalate to infra. I'll stand by. :eyes:

deploy-bot: ACTION: deployctl lock --reason "manual-review-latency-spike" --actor lin (executed) :white_check_mark:

josh: running pin now and then rollback for canary-A. rolling back only group to reduce blast radius.

josh: running: releasectl pin --svc hosted --region us-east-1 --version v3.0.1

josh: initiating rollback: rolloutctl revert --group canary-A --target-version v3.0.1 --reason "p95 regression"

lin: monitoring logs. I see decreased batching concurrency after revert. p95 trending down. good sign.

kate: draft release note: 

"We observed elevated latency for a canary cohort in us-east-1 on /v1/chat due to a batching optimization. We reverted the canary group to version v3.0.1 to restore expected latency. Impact: brief latency increase for a small portion of hosted traffic; no dedicated customers pinned. No action required. A postmortem will follow."

product-pm: looks good. keep the postmortem focused on batching heuristics and rollback criteria.

cs-lead: customer list confirmed: no pinned customers affected. will hold messaging unless we see dedicated impact.

josh: rollback complete for canary-A. group stable on v3.0.1. live telemetry: https://deploy.redwood/telemetry/canary-A?view=post-revert

sre-oncall: p95 back to baseline for the cohort. keeping watch for 30m.

lin: unlocking deploybot and closing change window after monitoring period. thanks all. retro tomorrow at 11am. :tada:
